label: Low-Dose Naltrexone: What is the Evidence? A Narrative Review.
summary: Naltrexone is prescribed off-label at low doses, typically 0.5-6.0 mg, for a variety of therapeutic indications. This review evaluates the clinical evidence for low-dose naltrexone (LDN). A literature search was conducted in February 2026 across PubMed, Embase and CINAHL for studies published from 1989 to 2026.
